semiconductor_relevance: Low — AIO Precision specializes in metal cutting and machining services, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AIO Precision provides in-house integrated production services, including cutting, grinding, heat treatment, and surface treatment. They focus on variable-mix, variable-volume production and welcome prototypes and single-piece orders.

regional_presence.Japan: AIO Precision is strategically located with access to major transportation hubs, enabling quick delivery throughout Japan.
